title: THE VELVET STATIC
subtitle: A phantom DJ, a vanished festival, and a lightning mark on every body
description: Three years ago the Velvet Static festival ended in a blackout nobody explained. Now the people who ran it are dying, one club at a time, across Goa, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Pune and Chennai. Find the lightning mark, read the green room lies, and name the DJ who never plays twice.

characters.name: Ryo Azevedo
characters.bio: Closed the festival's final set. Has not spoken on stage since.

characters.name: Ellie Barros
characters.bio: She kept the festival's real account books hidden.

characters.name: Salman Rehvi
characters.bio: Archived every set ever played at the festival.

characters.name: Pia Malhotra
characters.bio: Booked the mystery act under a fake name.

characters.name: Arav Krishnan
characters.bio: The only person who saw the stage the night of the blackout.

characters.name: Vivek Gokhale
characters.bio: Bought a crate of gear the week the festival collapsed.

characters.name: Swathi Rajan
characters.bio: Trained the voice behind the festival's famous closer.

characters.name: Maya Fernandes
characters.alibi: Was on a call with the mainland sponsor for two hours. Records exist.
statements: I built that festival. Someone burned it down.

characters.name: Zoya Qureshi
characters.alibi: Was restoring a vintage console in her studio, alone, by choice.
statements: A bolt is a sound, not a knife.
Every venue has a back door only the sound crew knows.

characters.name: Kabir Sen
characters.alibi: Streamed a live set to 40,000 people at the exact hour.
statements: I lost the headline slot to a ghost act.
I sample, I do not stab.

characters.name: Farhan Ali
characters.alibi: At a business dinner with city officials. Six witnesses.
statements: The private rooms have cameras. Check them.

characters.name: Dev Rathore
characters.alibi: Rigging a wedding stage until 2 AM, signed off by the venue.
statements: I make darkness. I do not use it.
The blackout was no accident. I said so then.

characters.name: Naina Pillai
characters.alibi: Recording in a booth with timestamped takes all night.
statements: I sang over the blackout. Nobody heard me.
The engineer kept staring at the door.

characters.name: Sana Mirza
characters.alibi: On a red-eye flight, manifest verified.
statements: The festival was insured to fail.

characters.name: Om Jadhav
characters.alibi: Working the door, on camera, all night.
statements: One guest always used the staff lift.

characters.name: Iris Dsouza
characters.alibi: Hosting backstage interviews, video confirmations for each segment.
statements: I know every green room secret.
The phantom act had a real rider list.

clues.name: The Bolt Mark
clues.desc: A jagged lightning bolt scratched into the surface. It is the Velvet Static's signature.

clues.name: The Wave Mark
clues.desc: A looping wave burned into the wall. A copycat is replaying the old signal.

clues.name: Frayed Mixer Cable
clues.desc: Cut with precision tooling only a sound engineer carries.

clues.name: Unlabelled USB Set
clues.desc: Three drives in a case, each wiped of its original festival recordings.

clues.name: Backstage Pass
clues.desc: A laminated pass two years out of date, refitted by the head bouncer's laminator.

clues.name: Energy Gel Packet
clues.desc: Torn open and squeezed dry. Whoever waited here planned to stay a while.

clues.name: Signed Vinyl Sleeve
clues.desc: The festival's rarest press, signed by the headliner who never plays again.

clues.name: Cracked Microphone
clues.desc: The capsule is fine. The impact came from a hand, not the drop.

clues.name: Conference SIM
clues.desc: A prepaid SIM registered to a stage-hand agency that dissolved years ago.

clues.name: Monogrammed Cufflink
clues.desc: A club owner's initial, dropped near the private lift.

clues.name: Cracked Stage Monitor
clues.desc: Blown at the exact frequency of the old festival's blackout tone.

clues.name: In-ear Monitor
clues.desc: Still warm, tuned to a private channel that no band was using.

clues.name: Cassette Tape Set
clues.desc: Labels rewritten in the same hand as the festival's master cue sheets.

clues.name: Stage Gloves
clues.desc: White gloves with rigging grease worked into every fingertip.

clues.name: Referee Whistle
clues.desc: A novelty whistle, the kind sold at the festival's final night.

clues.name: Security Lanyard
clues.desc: Stamped with the head bouncer's crew number.

clues.name: Burned Amp Fuse
clues.desc: Bypassed deliberately. This blackout was manufactured.

clues.name: Press Photo
clues.desc: A launch party photo with one face circled in label-executive red ink.

clues.name: Payroll Ledger
clues.desc: Ghost payments to a stage name that never appeared on any lineup.

clues.name: 9V Battery Pack
clues.desc: Half the cells are drained. Something was recording for hours.

clues.name: Lipstick Message
clues.desc: Written on the mirror in the victim's own shade, yet the victim never wore it.

clues.name: Studio Keychain
clues.desc: A rival DJ's tour keychain. Too obvious to be a mistake.

clues.name: Encrypted Flash Drive
clues.desc: Locked behind a six-digit code. The files are named after dead artists.

clues.name: Torn Backstage Banner
clues.desc: The old festival logo, sliced neatly along the lightning bolt.

situationTemplates: {VICTIM}, {VICTIM_ROLE}, was found after closing time in {CITY}. The speakers were still humming.
In {CITY}, {VICTIM} - {VICTIM_ROLE} - never made it to the encore. Every cable in the room has been examined except one.
The green room in {CITY} was locked from the inside. {VICTIM}, {VICTIM_ROLE}, was alone. Almost.
briefingTemplates: A {MARK} was left on the mirror, same as always. {MENACE} knows this venue's wiring better than the staff. Find every clue.
{MENACE} played this room once, years ago. The {MARK} proves they came back. {SUSPECT} swears the stage door was chained.
The blackout lasted eleven minutes. In that window, someone killed and walked out the crew entrance. The {MARK} is your only witness.
